name: WTT - M700 Long Action Realism Compatibility Patch
teaser: My first mod so far ! I've added compatibility for M700 & Realism , hope you like it !
description_html:
This is the first mod, i’ve never done any for a game so if you have any heads up to give me or if you think i missed something , please feel free to tell me in the comments!

The mod simply adds compatibility between the WTT - M700 Long Action by EpicRangeTime and the SPT Realism Mod by Fontaine. I tweaked some stats to my liking , tell me in the comments if you think something should be slightly changed.

If this mod goes well , i’ll think about adding new compatibilities in the future!

Installation :
- Download the file
- Extract it on the SPT folder or extract WTT-M700 Lapua - WTT-M700 Norma.json in user\mods\SPT-Realism\db\put_new_stuff_here
- Make sure that both WTT-M700 Long Action Lapua & WTT-M700 Long Action Norma mods are loading before Realism or the patch won’t be applied !
